q: You are on main. Which line is main's version?

q: Git refuses with the message below. What is wrong?
o: You have uncommitted changes that would be overwritten: commit them first
why: Git protects unsaved work. Commit it (or stash it), then switch.

q: The folders .venv and __pycache__ exist but are not listed. Why?
o: The .gitignore file tells Git to skip generated folders
why: Generated and downloadable files (a virtual environment, caches) do not belong in history. Your code and README do.
